lead.event: MAS holds policy settings and lowers its inflation forecast
lead.headline: MAS holds policy settings and lowers core inflation forecast to 1.5%-2%
lead.blurb: On 14 October, MAS left the slope, width and centre of its S$NEER policy band unchanged, after tightening in April and July. It lowered its core inflation forecast to 1.5%-2% and kept its headline inflation forecast at around 2%. Advance data showed third-quarter GDP growth of 5.4%, above the 5.1% median forecast. Most economists expected an extended hold through 2027, while HSBC expected a 25-basis-point slope increase in January 2027.

macro_flows.event: Knight Frank forecasts record Singapore property investment sales
macro_flows.headline: Knight Frank forecasts Singapore property sales could reach S$50 billion in 2026
macro_flows.blurb: Knight Frank Singapore says sales could reach around S$50 billion for 2026 after the first nine months’ S$42.4 billion topped the full-year 2025 record of S$40.7 billion. Interim head of capital markets Melvin Chay expects healthy 4Q momentum, with large deals in due diligence and possible rate hikes motivating parties to close transactions by year-end.

macro_flows.event: Singapore technology stocks fall amid a semiconductor selloff
macro_flows.headline: Singapore tech stocks fall in semiconductor selloff, CSE Global drops 10.294%
macro_flows.blurb: AEM and UMS Holdings fell 9.724% and 9.65%, while Frencken Group and Aztech Global each lost more than 5%. The selloff followed hotter-than-expected US September inflation data, raising expectations of further Federal Reserve rate increases and pressure on AI-related capital spending.

macro_flows.event: Singapore's September non-oil domestic exports release
macro_flows.headline: Singapore's September non-oil domestic exports rise 68.4% year on year
macro_flows.blurb: The increase beat the 32.2% consensus forecast in a Bloomberg poll and followed August's revised 46.1% expansion. Electronics exports grew 107.6% on AI-related demand, while non-electronics shipments rose 54.2%, led by non-monetary gold and specialised machinery.

macro_flows.event: Singapore bank shares slide amid earnings concerns
macro_flows.headline: Singapore bank shares shed US$22.4 billion amid earnings concerns
macro_flows.blurb: In the first week of October, OCBC fell 9.9%, UOB 7.9% and DBS 6% as fears of earnings downgrades drove selling; the Straits Times Index was 6.6% below its peak. November’s bank results are seen as the sector’s first real test.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Volta Infrastructure's US$5 billion AI loan syndication
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: Volta Infrastructure syndicates US$5 billion AI loan at yields above 11%
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: The loan is priced at 6.5 percentage points above benchmark and 95 US cents on the dollar. JPMorgan Chase and Goldman Sachs led the arrangement, underwriting the US$1.3 billion Norway data-centre lease loan but not the US$3.7 billion chip loan for about 36,000 Nvidia GPUs.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Seatrium launches a S$200 million share buyback
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: Seatrium launches S$200 million share buyback
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Funded from existing cash, the programme supports shareholder returns and employee incentives. Its current 2% mandate permits about 68 million shares, worth roughly S$136 million at S$2 each, with the balance requiring mandate renewals at future annual general meetings.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Genting announces a RM1.25 billion rights issue
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: Genting announces plan for RM1.25 billion rights issue
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: The renounceable offer will be priced at a 25% to 30% discount, with proceeds used to repay borrowings and fund working capital. Genting had RM45.3 billion in borrowings at end-June.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: AirTrunk delays its Singapore REIT IPO
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: AirTrunk delays planned US$1.5 billion Singapore REIT IPO to next year
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: The Blackstone-backed data centre operator had planned to gauge investor interest in October and had considered offering a roughly 6% yield, up from 5.5%. Higher interest rates and market volatility have tempered demand, according to people familiar with the matter.

deals_control.event: Hongkong Land discusses buying Hotel Properties' Orchard Road assets
deals_control.headline: Hongkong Land discusses buying majority stake in three Orchard Road properties
deals_control.blurb: The early-stage talks with Hotel Properties cover voco Orchard, Forum and HPL House. A deal could expand Hongkong Land’s Singapore retail presence, but talks may still fall through.

deals_control.event: Jardine Matheson raises guidance and buys out Gammon Construction
deals_control.headline: Jardine Matheson raises 2026 EPS guidance and buys out Gammon for £250 million
deals_control.blurb: The acquisition of Balfour Beatty’s remaining 50% stake makes Jardine Matheson sole owner of Gammon. The £250 million price is payable in three equal instalments, with the final due by 29 December 2028, and is expected to deliver modest earnings accretion from its first year. Underlying 2026 EPS guidance is US$5.50 to US$5.65, up from US$5.33.

deals_control.event: IOI Properties enters exclusive talks for CHIJMES and Capitol Kempinski
deals_control.headline: IOI Properties enters exclusive talks for assets valued at S$976 million
deals_control.blurb: IOI is conducting due diligence, but no purchase consideration has been agreed. Chief executive Lee Yeow Seng plans to bring high-end fashion brands to CHIJMES and replace the hotel with a global ultra-luxury brand.

deals_control.event: Beauty World Plaza launches a collective sale
deals_control.headline: Beauty World Plaza launches collective sale at S$165 million
deals_control.blurb: The asking price equates to about S$2,231 per square foot of gross floor area. Sole marketing agent ETC is conducting a public tender that closes at 3pm on 19 November.

market_structure_policy.event: Singapore probe into haze-linked palm oil companies
market_structure_policy.headline: Singapore investigates haze-linked palm oil companies as First Resources falls 9.1%
market_structure_policy.blurb: Prime Minister Lawrence Wong said Singapore would investigate which companies may be responsible for fires in Indonesia and act under the Transboundary Haze Pollution Act where warranted. Bumitama Agri fell as much as 7.5% and Golden Agri-Resources 6.9%. Greenpeace’s 5 October report linked Bumitama and First Resources to hotspots in Indonesian plantation concessions; First Resources denied the allegations.

other.event: ComfortDelGro-RATP Dev JV wins Copenhagen Metro operations contract
other.headline: ComfortDelGro JV wins Copenhagen Metro contract worth S$3.3 billion
other.blurb: The KBH Metro Partner venture with RATP Dev signed with Metroselskabet to operate and maintain lines M1 to M4. Operations are due to start in September 2027 under a 12-year term running until 2039, with an option to extend for three years to 2042.

earnings_guidance.event: Toku raises FY2026 revenue growth guidance
earnings_guidance.headline: Toku raises FY2026 revenue growth guidance to exceed 20%
earnings_guidance.blurb: After a review at the end of 3QFY2026 on 30 September, Toku expects 2HFY2026 revenue growth to exceed 26%, up from its previous outlook of more than 13%. Its order book rose 20.8% to US$35.4 million from 30 June.

earnings_guidance.event: CGS International upgrades DBS and raises its target price
earnings_guidance.headline: CGS International upgrades DBS and raises target price to S$79.50
earnings_guidance.blurb: The broker lifted its target from S$77.10, citing DBS’s 20% return on equity and projected FY2027 dividend yield of 4.8%, above the sector average of 4.3%. CGS International research head Zheng Weiquan expects Q3 FY2026 net profit of S$2.86 billion, down 3.2% year on year, with loan growth potentially offsetting margin pressure.

earnings_guidance.event: UOB Kay Hian upgrades DBS and sets a higher target price
earnings_guidance.headline: UOB Kay Hian upgrades DBS to Buy with S$83.60 target
earnings_guidance.blurb: The broker cites DBS's S$638 billion deposit base, with 54.4% of customer deposits in CASA accounts, as cushioning it from fixed-deposit promotions by UOB and OCBC. It expects dividend yields of 4.5% for FY2026 and 4.7% for FY2027.

earnings_guidance.event: DBS downgrades Singapore Exchange and cuts its target price
earnings_guidance.headline: DBS downgrades Singapore Exchange to hold and cuts target to S$20
earnings_guidance.blurb: The 12-month target was reduced from S$26.40. DBS Group Research also lowered earnings per share estimates by 4 to 5 per cent through FY2028, citing easing growth momentum in equities and derivatives and a lofty valuation ahead of Singapore Exchange’s first-half results.
